purpose: Defines exceptions to the default rule that a research node's declared capabilities become available at Mature, plus structural effects and deployment events enabled by selected technologies.

prototype_warp_drive.description: A demonstrated prototype proves limited interstellar transit is physically possible before the drive is mature/reliable enough for ordinary deployment.

biofabrication.description: Mature biological fabrication establishes a civilization-level biofabrication capability that can make later living-material/biological-industrial branches applicable.

synthetic_cognition.description: Knowing how to construct synthetic cognition does not mean a persistent machine population actually exists.

whole_mind_emulation.description: Whole-mind emulation provides another technological route by which persistent machine cognition can be instantiated.

persistent_machine_cognition_instantiate.description: Triggered only after at least one persistent autonomous synthetic cognition actually exists. Research enables the event; deployment creates the civilization trait.
